about: V4 picture-lock script: 26 lines, each with what is on screen and ElevenLabs delivery notes. Final takes go to public/voiceover/final/v4/Vxx.wav (no code change).
direction: Abhishek's own voice (or an approved voice clone of it): calm, deep, precise, confident, technical, understated. Use audio tags sparingly; the tag field is a suggestion, not a requirement.
